title: The unexpected personal-data form — question explanation
learningObjective: Share only information necessary for a legitimate and verified purpose
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: A person claiming to organize a campus event sends a form requesting your ID number, date of birth, home address and bank details to “confirm attendance.”
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Share only information necessary for a legitimate and verified purpose
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option A: Verify the organizer through the official event channel and ask which fields are necessary before sharing anything. Confirm purpose and legitimacy, then disclose only the minimum required information using an approved channel.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option B: A plausible event does not establish the form’s authenticity or justify collecting unrelated sensitive data. Option C: False information can create operational problems and still expose you to malicious links or follow-up requests. Option D: A different channel does not fix an unverified request or excessive data collection.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Contact the event organizer using a published official channel. Do not submit unnecessary financial or identity data. Check purpose, legitimacy and necessity before disclosing personal information.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Check purpose, legitimacy and necessity before disclosing personal information.
